review:
Fire Strike is a classic-style 3×5 slot with 10 paylines and a modern twist. Alongside regular line wins, Fire Strike symbols pay direct bonuses whenever six or more land anywhere on the reels, so the game can pay without lines.

The top prize is a jackpot of up to 25,000x the bet for filling the screen with 15 wild Fire Strike symbols. There are no free spins or complicated modifiers. Pragmatic lists a 96.50% RTP. It suits players who like old-school fruit-machine style games with one big target.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
